headword: {衝撃|しょうげき}を{受|う}ける
gloss: to be shocked; to receive a shock; to be struck by impact

definitions.gloss: to be emotionally shocked; to be deeply affected
definitions.explanation: To experience a strong emotional reaction, typically surprise mixed with distress, upon learning unexpected news or witnessing something startling.

definitions.gloss: to receive a physical impact; to sustain a shock
definitions.explanation: To be subjected to a physical force or blow.

examples.japanese: そのニュースに{衝撃|しょうげき}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I was shocked by the news.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めて{海外|かいがい}に{行|い}った{時|とき}、{文化|ぶんか}の{違|ちが}いに{衝撃|しょうげき}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: When I went abroad for the first time, I was shocked by the cultural differences.

examples.japanese: {尊敬|そんけい}していた{先輩|せんぱい}の{突然|とつぜん}の{退職|たいしょく}に、{職場|しょくば}{全体|ぜんたい}が{衝撃|しょうげき}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: The entire workplace was shocked by the sudden resignation of the senior colleague they admired.

examples.japanese: {頭|あたま}に{衝撃|しょうげき}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I received a blow to the head.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}は{地震|じしん}の{衝撃|しょうげき}を{受|う}けて{壁|かべ}にひびが{入|はい}った。
examples.english: The building received the impact of the earthquake and cracks appeared in the walls.

examples.japanese: {強|つよ}い{衝撃|しょうげき}を{受|う}けると{壊|こわ}れるおそれがありますので、{丁寧|ていねい}にお{取|と}り{扱|あつか}いください。
examples.english: It may break if subjected to a strong impact, so please handle with care.

notes:
A common expression combining {衝撃|しょうげき} (shock; impact) and {受|う}ける (to receive). The emotional sense (sense 1) is far more common in everyday conversation than the physical sense (sense 2). When used emotionally, it describes a strong, sudden reaction — stronger than {驚|おどろ}く (to be surprised) but not necessarily negative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}きな{衝撃|しょうげき}を{受|う}ける: to receive a big shock
- ～に{衝撃|しょうげき}を{受|う}ける: to be shocked by ~
- {強|つよ}い{衝撃|しょうげき}を{受|う}ける: to receive a strong impact
- カルチャーショックを{受|う}ける: to experience culture shock

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ショックを{受|う}ける: to be shocked — casual equivalent using the loanword
- {驚|おどろ}く: to be surprised — milder, does not necessarily imply emotional distress
- {愕然|がくぜん}とする: to be stunned — literary, emphasizes being rendered speechless
